_comment: Laboratory creation rows of classes the 1.69 server content does not create (docs/future/new-classes.md 8.13). heroesContents.db3 has CharacterClassInfo and CharacterBaseLoadInfo for Delia (class 10) but no DefaultItemInfo, DefaultSkillInfo or INNERARMOR case. These rows follow Hagie, the last class of the 1.69 switch: the same consumables and gold, the class's newbie weapon, its weapon mastery at rank 1 (LevelConstraint 8, so GiveSkill skips it at level 1 as it skips Hagie's) and the class's free inner armor with the default colours of the free inners (Evy, Arisha). They are a laboratory choice, not recovered NA data; content_additions.connect appends them to the two tables, after the original rows. Miri (class 11) is imported from the NA client (class_imports.py: items, skills and CharacterClassInfo/CharacterBaseLoadInfo copied from Delia); her rows follow Delia's: the same consumables and gold, the NA newbie Draker, her Draker mastery and speed move (her rank-1 movement skill) and the NA free inner armor with the free inners' colours.
